_comment: Stack members wired to the r6data API. Add an entry per player; the daily GitHub Action (player-stats.yml) fetches each and writes players.json. platform: uplay | psn | xbl | steam.
_handle_note: Leave handle empty ("") to reserve a slot without linking — it shows a 'not linked yet' card and costs no API calls. Fill in the exact Ubisoft name (with any trailing dot) to activate it.
_api_key_note: The R6DATA_API_KEY secret expires ~90 days after issue. Update api_key_expires whenever you rotate the key so the app/Action can warn before it dies.
